title: Move our capability/object URNs to urn:jmap:*
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[chat-core] Move chat-family capability URN constants to urn:jmap:*
Spec (57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L299: "# The urn:jmap:chat Capability {#capability}"; L1845-1853: "## The urn:jmap Namespace ... jmap-urn = \"urn:jmap:\" segment *( \":\" segment )"; IANA (L1837): "Capability Name: `urn:jmap:chat`". jmap-chat-compliance-tests.md L159: "Verify `capabilities[\"urn:jmap:chat:push\"]` at session level is `{}`"; L171: "SEPARATE from `urn:jmap:chat:websocket` (which must be `{}`)". Spec HEAD uses urn:jmap:chat, :push, :websocket, :filenode, :calendars, :tasks, :did, :mimi; RFC-defined urn:ietf:params:jmap:{core,mail,submission,websocket,webpush-vapid,calendars,tasks,filenode,blob,blob2,metadata,refplus,error:*} unchanged.
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:25 JMAP_CHAT_URI; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:28 JMAP_CHAT_PUSH_URI; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:32 JMAP_CHAT_FILENODE_URI; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:41 JMAP_CHAT_CALENDARS_URI; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:50 JMAP_CHAT_TASKS_URI; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:54 JMAP_CHAT_WEBSOCKET_URI; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:63 JMAP_CHAT_DID_URI; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/capability.rs:539 (in-module assert literal); crate-jmap-chat-mimi-types/src/capability.rs:15 JMAP_CHAT_MIMI_URI; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/call.rs:33 private JMAP_CHAT_URI duplicate; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/region.rs:29 pub(crate) JMAP_CHAT_URI duplicate
Now: All chat-family capability constants are urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat[:*]. A spec-conformant peer/client advertising or sending urn:jmap:chat in `using` gets unknownCapability; our server advertises a name no conformant client looks up. CHAT_FILENODE_SPACE_ROLE (capability.rs:109) is already urn:jmap:chat:filenode:space.
Change: Change each constant value to the urn:jmap:chat[:suffix] form; replace the private duplicates in vtc-server/call.rs:33 and scene-server/region.rs:29 with the jmap_chat_types constant (or update the literal). Update constant tests that assert the old value. Coordinate with a CHANGELOG entry (wire break).
